notes.title: Major Performance Update!
notes.notes:
In this update I've added new optimizations to allow Sneak Thief to run on more systems at 60 fps. Any system with a modern GPU should now be able to run Sneak Thief at high settings averaging 60 fps. Older GPUs/Systems will now be able to support the game as well. Essentially the performance of the game should no longer be an issue! (So long as you have a modern computer with dedicated graphics)

So whats new?
-Added Dynamic Resolution
-Added Support for Nvidia DLSS
-Moved some lights from real-time to baked to decrease gpu overhead
- Switched from C# JIT Compiler to IL2CPP, meaning instead of running in the mono VM the game is directly compiled to machine code. Decreasing the size of the game on disk and increasing the performance of the game.
 
I know most of these features should have been available on launch however with the time it took to get 1.0 out I felt pressured to release it. With any new update comes the potential for more bugs so please report any issues and I will have them fixed ASAP. 

More to come soon!

notes.title: The next update...
notes.notes:
[b]Where have the updates been?[/b]
It has been a while hasn't it! I've been getting a lot of questions regarding if the game has been abandoned, if development has stopped etc. Simply put, it hasn't.
[b]So why is it taking so long?[/b]
The game is being updated to a way newer version of the unity engine (2019.2) to be exact, the game was originally developed in unity 5.4. Unity 5.4 for reference was released in 2016, unfortunately there are many systems in that engine that the game heavily relies on that are not longer in 2019.2 (some have been upgraded some completely removed.) So there are a lot of changes to the core systems of the game that had to be made, which (in layman's terms) takes a lot of time because replacing the core systems creates a lot of bugs. In addition the game's graphics and performance are getting a massive overhaul (more on that later). The game initially took 1 year to develop and only released with 5 levels (plus a tutorial). The game now has 15 levels (plus a tutorial and another one in the works), so updating everything takes some time. I hope however that the time spent on this update will not only take the game out of early access but allow it to reach the full potential that it has.
[b]What will be in the update?[/b]
[u][i]- New Graphics[/i][/u]
Nearly every texture is being replaced with photoscans, new decals are being added, new particle systems, reworked lighting, and many mesh replacements are being done.
[u][i]- Increased performance[/i][/u]
Most of the performance issues in the game stem from the AI system. All of the AI sight was being calculated on the main thread (making the game very dependent on a single cpu core). With the new engine update we can utilize Unity Jobs to distribute the raycasting across multiple threads drastically reducing the amount of time it takes to calculate, increasing fps, and increasing the amount of AI we can have per level. There are also other areas in the game we are looking to add multi-threading support to.
[u][i]- New Level[/i][/u]
More on this soon ;)
[u][i]- New modding system[/i][/u]
I will no longer be attempting to make an in game level editor. Rather the raw game files will be released as a unity package where you will be able to alter levels and models as well as create your own levels, weapons, enemies, etc! You will also be able to publish on the workshop.
[b]When is the release date?[/b]
Originally I wanted to release this in January however because of school I didn't have much time to work on it plus the scope of the update also got way bigger then initially expected. Right now I plan to release late August, however there are no promises it will be out by then. That being said If I am still working by the end of September I will release all the complete parts of the update and the rest will come after.
I will also try to release some screenshots of all the new graphics by next week.

As always if you have any questions feel free to leave them below and I will try to answer as soon as possible!

Please remember the editor is in beta and will NOT work properly also most assets are a not yet included and will be added soon. I'll be releasing a more complete guide on using the editor but just for quick reference I put a simple guide together on some basics.

When you start the editor and want to create a new map enter what you would like to call the map in the text box then press new or if you would like to load a map within your custom maps folder type the name of the map in the box and press load. Once you are ready to save just press save.

To play custom maps all you have to do is take the map you downloaded put it in the custom maps folder within your game files then go to the community levels menu and select the map you want to play.

notes.notes:
[b][u]Please note: This level is not complete and may contain bugs and have missing content.[/u][/b]

It's finally here! Please let me know what bugs you run into! Also this level is not the complete version of the new level, it does not contain all content that will be in the final level. New features in this level such as the more efficient AI and new weapons will be added later to other levels once they have been confirmed to work.

You should expect to see on this level an increase in fps compared to other levels as it utilizes a brand new AI system and new methods of optimization. However this new system comes with bugs and before it is added to other levels I need to make sure all bugs are addressed so please tell me if you run into any issues!
[i]
*The following was already shown in the last update just here in case you havent seen it[/i]

- New Combat System (Melee weapons)! 
- New weapons including the stun baton, pictured below, axes, a baseball bat, knives, and much more! 
- New AI system, based on testing it is much more efficient then what is in the current levels. The new AI system won't be put in the old levels until I am sure that the system works well. 
- Improved hiding mechanic 
             - Such as hiding in closets
- New puzzles 
The premise of the level is, you are robing a mansion that contains well protected antiques. To get this antiques you must complete puzzles while evading traps and guards. To be able to get enough money to leave you must steal from multiple antique locations, so you must complete more then one major puzzle, unlike other levels. Each puzzle will have randomized answers, the guards will have randomized patrol paths and guard locations, weapon locations will be randomized, and loot locations will partialy be randomized. These systems will be implemented after the release of the new level on the old levels once each system is confirmed to work properly.
